summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Hephaestus killed with missiles of red-hot metal in the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Mimas among the Giants whom Hephaestus felled with missiles of red-hot metal when the gods, with Heracles' aid, destroyed the earthborn brood. The collective node `gigantes` holds the Gigantomachy; this node is the individual in the battle roster.
